name: com.dabugs/shop
title: DABUGS Shop
description: Shop DABUGS Vietnamese Y2K women's fashion: search, sizes, quote and place COD/bank/VNPAY orders.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the DABUGS catalog (women's tops, skirts, jeans, shorts…). Returns handle, title, category, price/finalPrice in VND, colors, sizes, inStock, url, image.

query.description: Keywords in Vietnamese or English, e.g. 'chân váy jeans', 'pink shorts', 'baby tee'

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product: every variant (sku, color, size, price, finalPrice, inStock), images, description and size chart (cm).

handle.description: Product handle/code from search_products, e.g. QS-005

tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.description: Validate items, stock, address and compute the exact total (auto vouchers + free shipping). Returns a summary and a quote_token valid 30 minutes. Does NOT create an order.

items.description: One line. Use `sku` (preferred, from get_product) OR `handle` + `color` + `size`.

sku.description: Variant SKU from get_product, e.g. HOG-M-QS-005 (format: color-size-category-number)

color.description: Color name as listed by get_product

size.description: Size, e.g. XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

phone.description: Vietnamese mobile number of the recipient, e.g. 0912345678

street.description: House number + street (số nhà, tên đường)

ward.description: Ward / commune (phường / xã) — NEW 2-level name (since 07/2025). Unsure? call find_address

district.description: Optional old district (quận/huyện) if the user gives one — kept in the street line only

province.description: Province / city, one of the 34 provinces, e.g. Hồ Chí Minh, Hà Nội (old province names are mapped automatically)

lat.description: Optional latitude of the delivery point — needed for express (Grab) delivery

lng.description: Optional longitude of the delivery point

payment_method.description: cod = cash on delivery · bank = bank transfer QR · vnpay = VNPAY payment link

shipping_method.description: standard = free nationwide · express = same-day Grab, TP.HCM only (send lat/lng), fee shown in the quote

voucher_codes.description: Discount codes the user has (automatic vouchers are applied anyway; invalid codes are reported, not applied)

gift_sku.description: SKU of the free gift the user picked, when the quote's giftOffer says eligible

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Create the real order from a quote_token. Call ONLY after the user has seen the prepare_checkout summary and explicitly confirmed. Returns order id + payment instructions (QR / payment link for bank / vnpay).

user_confirmed.description: Must be true: the user explicitly confirmed this exact order

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status, payment state and tracking number of an order. Requires the order id and the recipient phone number used for the order.

phone.description: Recipient phone used for the order

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Build a dabugs.com link that fills the user's cart with these SKUs and opens checkout, so the user can finish the purchase in their own browser (works on phones).

tools.name: find_address
tools.description: Look up official Vietnamese province and ward/commune names (2-level system since 07/2025, same list the courier uses). Without province: list the 34 provinces. With province (+ optional query): list/search its wards. Use it when prepare_checkout returns unknown_province / unknown_ward.

province.description: Province name, e.g. Hồ Chí Minh

query.description: Part of the ward name, e.g. 'Tân Sơn'

tools.name: get_store_policies
tools.description: Shipping, returns/exchange, payment methods, contact information and the promotions running right now (bundle sets, buy-more discounts, free gift thresholds).
